about: Synthetic labelled drafts for the fictional Brewline Coffee brand. 'expected' lists every real mistake a careful brand reviewer would flag in that draft. A draft with an empty list has no mistakes. An expected item marked 'ai' is wording only an AI judge could reasonably catch, so it is left out of the rule-based recall and counted for the AI judge instead. Labels were written from the guidelines and fact sheet, not from what the engine returns.

cases.title: Clean launch email
cases.body:
Subject: Meet Brewline Signature Blend

Hello,

Our new Signature Blend is a medium-dark roast made from beans grown in Coorg and Chikmagalur. A 250g pouch is ₹449.

With warmth,
Brewline

cases.title: The demo launch email
cases.body:
Subject: Meet Brewline Signature Blend

Hi there,

Dude, our new Signature Blend is insanely good, you'll be hooked from the first sip!!!

India's #1 coffee is finally here. Grab a 250g pouch for just ₹399, a cheap price for beans sourced from Coorg and Chikmagalur.

Launching on 1 December 2026, it is a light roast made for slow mornings.

Pre-order today and taste the difference.

Warmly,
Neha, Brewline Coffee team
